rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `section_prose` on `reckon/_plan_html.py` is one reader hiding span subtraction, skip-set interior removal, tag stripping, entity decoding and the landed-card mode behind one ordered-slice return; `_review_coverage` is one predicate over the two existing readers `roadmap.implementable_sections` and `list_plan_reviews`; neither spreads its complexity across shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan names each duplicate it found and the owner to extend: the plan-level report root built twice (`reckon/crew/plan_review.py:795`, `:866`) collapses to one private root function, the snapshot name spelled at `reckon/crew/recovery.py:547` becomes a private constant beside `_REVIEW_SIDECAR_NAME` (`plan_review.py:784`), the gate's record pick at `reckon/crew/routing.py:2666` retires into `read_plan_review`, and the `read_plan_review` whole-document match retires into `_review_coverage`; no owner is forked.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1481, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; each open section carries an interface-accounting paragraph naming what it adds and what it retires — §16 net +1 (`section_prose` added, interim public `strip_tags` made private), §21 nothing public, §22 `plan_review_settings` added as `plan_review_settle_seconds` is retired, §23 `store_delivered_reviews` added as `store_delivered_report` goes private — and none adds a CLI option, MCP view or refusal family without accounting (§23 reuses the existing `plan-review-missing` family and an existing sidecar key).
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan searched the target codebase thoroughly for every mechanism it proposes (the fourteen-site prose-extractor census is exact, the three converging readers are correct, the duplicate owners are correctly located, and §22 states why no existing similarity machinery can be extended), but its census of the call sites a replacement must repoint is understated.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every wrapper-shaped addition is a widening or hoist of an existing owner with the reason in the section's own text: `plan_review_settings` widens `plan_review_settle_seconds`'s three single-key sites in `reckon/flight.py` to a table, `store_delivered_reviews` hoists the one existing store loop beside `store_delivered_report`, and §22 states plainly why the change measure is not an extension of `dispatch._longest_contiguous_word_span`.
